universe.review_universe_note: Legacy denominator: requirements carrying at least one review reason in the original three-catalog layer.

caution: 5,835 是旧三层目录时代的“带复核原因”分母，不是未覆盖数。
1,003 个岗位的旧原因在现行五目录层已不再复现；这表示本工具的旧告警消失，不等于岗位已核清。
有目录候选不等于约束解析完整，更不等于个人可报。

bucket_definitions.no_candidate_agency_no_public_list: no catalog candidate; agency verified to publish no membership list
bucket_definitions.no_candidate_agency_unverified: no catalog candidate; agency uses in-house categories but publication not verified
bucket_definitions.no_candidate_other: no catalog candidate; national catalog vocabulary or open scope
bucket_definitions.candidate_with_conflict: has candidate; a printed name contradicts the code
bucket_definitions.candidate_with_exclusion: has candidate; exclusion or negative condition present
bucket_definitions.candidate_with_degree_scope: has candidate; clause/degree scope still ambiguous
bucket_definitions.candidate_with_unresolved_vocabulary: has candidate; another term remains unresolved
bucket_definitions.candidate_with_open_scope: has candidate; 相关/等/方向 style open scope
bucket_definitions.candidate_with_namespace_ambiguity: has candidate; multiple catalog nodes for one name
bucket_definitions.candidate_legacy_reason_superseded: has candidate; the legacy review reason no longer reproduces
